Live only

Demand waits for a date

Someone who finds you the day after a class has to wait for the next one, with no replay. A lot of that interest cools off before then.

Free for everyone

Free doesn’t filter

A free class is great for reach, but it can’t tell you who is ready to invest in their events business and who is just curious.

No middle step

A big jump to 6 months

Going from a free class straight to a 6-month program is a big step. A small first purchase makes the next one feel natural.

Your class and your program already work. What’s missing is an always-on front door that can be fed every day, and a paid step that shows who’s ready for Community Mastery.

Questions

Before you grab the kit

Do I need to be hosting events already?

No. The kit works whether you’re planning your first event or growing a community that already meets.

Is this the same as the free masterclass?

No. The masterclass covers the whole 5-step framework. The kit goes deep on one part of it: sponsors and venues, with the templates done for you. Buyers also get a seat at my next live class.

How long does it take?

The video training is 60 minutes. Most people send their first pitch the same week.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Use the kit, send your pitches, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper with me.

Educational content. Results depend on your city, your community and the work you put in.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts: talking to camera

Shot the same way as your reels. 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “Brands want your community”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you host events for your community, brands want to be in that room. Most hosts just never ask.”

Body

“When I started, I didn’t know what to send a brand, so I didn’t send anything. What changed it was a simple deck, a clear package and a short pitch that tells them exactly who shows up and what they get.”

CTA

“I put all of it in the Sponsor-Ready Kit. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, then a quick cut of the deck template on a laptop.

Script 2 · “Stop paying for everything”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Your events shouldn’t be coming out of your own pocket.”

Body

“Two things change that: venue partners, so one of your biggest costs comes down, and sponsors, gifted or paid, who want to reach your people. You don’t need a huge following. You need a clear pitch.”

CTA

“The Sponsor-Ready Kit walks you through both, with the scripts done for you. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “venues + sponsors” with “sponsors” highlighted in lime.

Script 3 · “What to put in a sponsor deck”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s what goes in a sponsor deck for a community event.”

Body

“One: who comes, in a sentence. Two: what the brand gets, like sampling, a moment on stage or content. Three: your packages, from gifted to paid. Four: photos of real people having a great time. Keep it to five slides.”

CTA

“Want the template? It’s in the Sponsor-Ready Kit for $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, numbering each point on fingers, cut to the template close-up.
